headline: KMT caucus proposes NT$20,000 universal cash handout; hopes for smooth third reading on 11/20 | Politics
summary: The KMT legislative caucus backs a NT$20,000 universal cash handout and a special act on sharing economic achievements. Cross-party negotiations are set for the 17th, with a third reading hoped for on the 20th.
why: Universal cash handouts inject fiscal spending into household consumption and can affect government budgets and public debt.
